status: relaunched 2026-08-11 on av2 and av3 at b093374 — 800 runs (400 per host), single stage, in progress. Two earlier executions of this design completed and were discarded; see superseded_executions.
method: Recorded at launch, not reconstructed. Both hosts report counter --version and compare --version into the per-host launch manifest, and run_experiments.py refused to start until each binary's commit matched the working tree's HEAD with dirty=0; that gate was left on, so no --allow-stale-binary was used.

superseded_executions.what: The same design ran once at 536a3ae, launched 2026-08-10T15:37+0100, and completed 800 runs (av2 400/400, av3 399/400, one counter exit-1 on round-robin-arbiter seed 21). That data was DISCARDED, not archived: the CSVs, run directories and per-host manifests were deleted from both hosts before the next launch.
superseded_executions.why: Three engine commits landed on main while it ran. d7733fc gates written repairs on a shared correctness table, which changes what counts as a repair and so redefines this campaign's primary outcome. fb4c3ed stops black answering validity wrong on weak-until, which the elitism campaign found had produced tautological repairs. b101ada folds well-separation into the status score, and experiments/README.md records that status is a selection objective on both paths, so quality figures do not compare across it.
superseded_executions.disposition: Discarded on the owner's instruction rather than kept as a pre-b101ada record. 536a3ae is not reachable from main and no provenance tag holds it, so the shas naming that execution will stop resolving once the objects are collected. This is deliberate — nothing cites them.

superseded_executions.what: The re-run at df66e44, launched 2026-08-10T17:51+0100, completed 800 runs on both hosts (av2 86.7 min, av3 98.7 min) but lost 66 of them to `counter` aborting with `unexpected output from black: syntax error: <stdin>: Expected identifier, found '0'`. 734 rows landed. DISCARDED, not archived.
superseded_executions.why: A defect in fb4c3ed that this campaign was the first to exercise. rewrite_weak_operators calls ltlfilt --remove-wm, the first path on which a SPOT-printed string reaches black; SPOT spells the boolean constants 0 and 1 and black rejects them as a syntax error. The pre-existing constant-fold guard tests simplify_ltl's output, which returns its input unchanged on a timeout, and --simplify is the pass that blows up super-exponentially on deep nested-X conjunctions while --remove-wm does not.
superseded_executions.disposition: Discarded because the loss is not missing at random and not balanced. A run aborts only where the search reaches such a formula, so the rate is a function of what each scheme explores; it fell 38 nsga2-apportion against 28 nsga2-truncate, and round-robin-arbiter dropped from 40 paired seeds to 23. Dropping unpaired rows biases the paired comparison the decision rule reads. Fixed by b093374, which is the commit this campaign now runs at.

question: Whether nsga2-apportion's yield advantage on examples/arbiter (120/120 against nsga2-truncate's 0/120 in 2026-07-31-replicate) is a family-level effect across arbitration specifications or a property of that one spec. The pre-registered decision rule is in PLAN.md §7.

binary_commit.subject: fix(black): answer SPOT's constant spellings instead of forwarding them
binary_commit.evidence: counter --version and compare --version both reported commit=b093374, dirty=0 on each host at launch, written into experiments/results-arbiter-probe-manifest-avlab12.json and -av3.json. Every CSV row carries the commit and dirty columns. The hosts are checked out at b093374 itself; the provenance commit recording this sits after it on the branch and is not checked out on either host, which is what keeps the binary and the working-tree HEAD in agreement for the stale-binary gate.

stages.note: Own CSV (results-arbiter-probe.csv) and configs (configs-arbiter-probe/), shared with no other profile. jobs=1 for ltlsynt RAM, as with every TLSF profile; the ltl2tgba orphan-reaper cron was verified installed on both hosts before launch.

config_vintage.elitism_rate: Pinned to 0.1 in the emitted config rather than inherited. 2026-08-07-elitism closed on 2026-08-10 keeping 0.1 on cost alone, so the pin and the current default agree; the pin is kept regardless, because gen_configs.py writes a key only where a sweep overrides it and an inherited value would leave this archive restating whatever the binary later defaults to.
config_vintage.metric: The emitted config pins model_counting.metric = "direct", where config.hpp defaults to Logarithmic. This is the gen_configs.py campaign baseline that every prior sweep shares, including 2026-07-31-replicate, whose finding this campaign extends. Matching the campaign under test was preferred to matching the shipped default; see PLAN.md §4.
config_vintage.unpinned: run_vacuity and run_well_separation are deliberately left unpinned and take the binary's defaults at b093374: run_vacuity true, run_well_separation FALSE. The latter is the second move of a key that has now crossed the line twice — false before 86e463c, true between it and b101ada, false again from b101ada, which folded the property into the status score. Reproducing this campaign means building b093374; writing the key back at any single value does not reconstruct it, because b101ada also changed what the status scale means and no config key restores that.

comparability.to_2026-07-31-replicate: Not comparable row for row. The engine has since gained the tautology screen (3869c53), the fold of the false-condition filter into vacuity, the correct-offspring rescue fix, the flip of run_well_separation and allow_output_assumptions to true (86e463c) and its partial reversal (b101ada), the shared correctness gate on written repairs (d7733fc), and the weak-until rewrite before black (fb4c3ed) together with the constant-spelling fix it needed (b093374). The last four postdate this campaign's own first execution. Both arms here are collected fresh at one commit, so the paired within-campaign comparison is internally valid and no cross-campaign join is required by the decision rule.
comparability.selection_scheme_names: This is the first campaign archived under the post-2026-08-06 spellings. Its configs set nsga2-truncate and nsga2-apportion, and its CSV selection column reads the same, so canonical_scheme() is an identity on these rows rather than a rename.
